Class PeriodicTableWorldArtwork

java.lang.Object
io.github.wurtzitane.avogadro.client.PeriodicTableWorldArtwork
public final class PeriodicTableWorldArtwork extends Object
Draws full-bright poster artwork after Demonica's world post-processing. The normal world depth buffer is shared with its final framebuffer, so the artwork remains hidden behind blocks and entities. Only visible main-pass submissions are retained, and only until the end of the same world frame.

    • draw

      public static void draw(net.minecraftforge.client.event.RenderWorldLastEvent event)
      Demonica completes its final pass before this event. Restore each submitted camera and draw into the existing depth buffer, outside shader color grading, temporal filtering, bloom and depth of field. Every graphics change and all per-frame entity references are released even if a draw fails.
